name: FunTanariZ
source: FunTanariZ is a Visual Novel game that tells story about Miyumi (default name, you can change it in the game) to seek the truth behind her husband accident. Many obstacles and mysteries that will she faced. Will she succeed in the end? It depends on which path she takes.
translation: FunTanariZ是一款视觉小说游戏，讲述Miyumi（默认名称，你可以在游戏中更改）寻找丈夫事故背后真相的故事。她将面临许多障碍和谜团。她最终会成功吗？这取决于她走哪条路。
